title: RF electrode of a silicon modulator (metal-only coplanar strips)

device.name: Metal-only control line of the Baehr-Jones 2012 modulator: two aluminum strips, 50 um wide, 5 um gap, on 2 um BOX over a 750 ohm cm handle

reference.citation: Baehr-Jones et al., Optics Express 20(11), 12014 (2012), doi:10.1364/OE.20.012014, metal-only line at 10 GHz

rows.method: femwell, bulk aluminum (3.77e7 S/m), strips meshed
rows.convergence: second-order elements (the contour-current impedance is not converged at order 1, notebook Step 1); no mesh-refinement study recorded; on the J1vb mesh (22,380 triangles) the loss differs by 0.03%
rows.hardware: laptop, Intel64 Family 6 Model 197 Stepping 2, 16 logical cores, Windows 11

rows.note: Computed on the cloud by Palace 0dd8d015, which predates the wave-port Z_PV fix awslabs/palace#1119 (merged 9 Nov); its Z_PV is real-valued, so femwell's -2.19j has no counterpart. |Z| is 2.3 % below femwell's |Z| of 57.38 ohm; the distance in the complex plane, 4.4 %, includes the missing imaginary part. The likely cause is the missing fix, which has not been checked. A rerun with a Palace that has #1119 is pending. Job: J1vb at 10 GHz (jobs_submitted in provenance.json; no cloud job identifier is recorded). The row pal-j1vb-z0 (57.26 - 2.19j) is kept as reported
